title: Investigate coastal and invalid Census county references from #428
body:
Parent: #428. This is a separately bounded, blocked follow-up created to carry forward the exact evidence gap recorded by that packet.

**Scope:** Exact eight county subjects flagged in #428: five coastal Georgia comparison signals and three self-intersecting Census TIGER reference geometries. Determine county-specific source vintage, boundary/shoreline treatment, and whether any discrepancy warrants an engineering proposal. Preserve original references; do not treat generalized CBF or IoU as legal boundary evidence.

**Acceptance:** Provide dated, sourced, reproducible findings for each of the eight IDs; distinguish invalid reference geometry from Atlas correctness and identify any required engineering follow-up.

No shared geography/source catalog edits, publication, region approval, or historical imports. Maintain exact source receipts, restoration/license limits, reproduction commands, dated progress, and unresolved uncertainty in the owned directory.
